title: Self-supervised Clipped-objective Reinforcement Leaning Framework for Risk-aware Portfolio Management
abstract: arXiv:2611.33652v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Portfolio management involves balancing diverse financial assets, a critical yet challenging task in quantitative trading. Although deep reinforcement learning has emerged as an active research domain for solving complex sequential decision-making problems over the past decade, deploying reinforcement learning frameworks in non-stationary financial markets raises formidable difficulties. Most existing reinforcement learning-based portfolio management models fail to account for tick-level intraday market dynamics (e.g., order flow imbalances and liquidity fluctuations), which reflect rapid capital movements. Simultaneously, these models suffer from unstable learning processes due to reinforcement learning's inherent high variance. This paper presents a Self-supervised Clipped-objective Portfolio management framework (SCP), which addresses these limitations through a two-phase architecture. translated_title: 面向风险感知投资组合管理的自监督截断目标强化学习框架
translated_abstract: 投资组合管理涉及对多种金融资产的平衡配置，是量化交易中一项至关重要且充满挑战的任务。尽管在过去十年中，深度强化学习已成为解决复杂序贯决策问题的活跃研究领域，但在非平稳金融市场中部署强化学习框架会带来巨大的困难。大多数现有的基于强化学习的投资组合管理模型未能考虑到逐笔级别的日内市场动态（例如订单流失衡和流动性波动），而这些动态反映了资金的快速流动。同时，由于强化学习固有的高方差特性，这些模型在学习过程中存在不稳定的问题。本文提出了一种自监督截断目标投资组合管理框架（SCP），通过两阶段架构来解决这些局限性。市场特征整合阶段（应用……摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出自监督截断目标投资组合管理框架（SCP），通过两阶段架构融合逐笔级别的日内市场动态信息并稳定强化学习的高方差训练过程，从而实现风险感知的投资组合管理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Self-supervised Clipped-objective Portfolio management framework (SCP), which uses a two-phase architecture to incorporate tick-level intraday market dynamics and stabilize the high-variance reinforcement learning training process, enabling risk-aware portfolio management.
